title: Walnut and Apricot Oat Cookies
blurb: Soft, naturally sweet cookies made with mashed banana, dried fruit and oats. A wholesome snack that needs no added sugar.
steps: Heat your oven to 180°C and line a baking tray with baking paper.
Peel the bananas and mash them thoroughly in a large bowl with a fork until mostly smooth.
Chop the walnuts finely, either with a knife or by pulsing briefly in a food processor, then chop the apricots into small pieces.
Stir the applesauce into the mashed banana, then add the chopped walnuts, apricots and oats, mixing until everything is evenly combined.
Drop spoonfuls of the mixture onto the prepared tray, spacing them a little apart, and flatten each one slightly with the back of the spoon.
Bake for 25 to 30 minutes until the cookies are golden at the edges and firm to the touch, then transfer to a wire rack to cool.
